subject: MAP kickoff: Compliance contacts & SOC 2 evidence plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 13:12:00 -0500
Subject: MAP kickoff: Compliance contacts & SOC 2 evidence plan

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on the compliance milestones that will unblock a pilot and contract signature. The goal here is to make roles and timelines explicit so we don’t get stalled by evidence requests.

High-level proposed milestones (attached: proposed_map_v1.xlsx):
- Week 1: POC rollcall & evidence owner assignment (this email)
- Week 2: SOC 2 evidence collection (document list + shared folder)
- Week 3: Security review call (30–45 min) + follow-ups
- Week 4: Final eval/pilot + commercial sign-off

A few asks to get us started:
1) Please confirm the primary GRC/security POC for evidence collection and the legal/procurement POC for contract review.
2) If you have a preferred way to share evidence (S3 link, secure SharePoint, or DocuSign/Secure Folder), tell us and we’ll use that.
3) Target close date on your end (ballpark) so we can align internal resources.

Attached is a one-page SOC 2 evidence request template (soc2_evidence_request.pdf) — we use this to map required artifacts. If you want, we can pre-populate with what we can provide (config screenshots, encryption docs, audit logs) and you can point to gaps.

Proposed call windows this week: Tue/Wed 10–12 ET or Thu 14–16 ET.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this in motion.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: proposed_map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), soc2_evidence_request.pdf (doc)
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nebulahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@nebulahealth.com>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Compliance contacts & SOC 2 evidence plan

Sean —

Thanks for putting this together. Happy to be the primary security/GRC contact for evidence collection. Marcus (cc’d) will be our legal lead for contract and procurement questions. Jordan is our infra lead and can provide logs/config screenshots as needed.

Short answers to your asks:
- Primary GRC/Security POC: Alyssa Chen (security@g: alyssa.chen@nebulahealth.com)
- Legal/procurement POC: Marcus Li (marcus.li@nebulahealth.com)
- Preferred transfer method: We can provision a secure S3 bucket and provide time-limited credentials. If you prefer Drive links, we will accept but S3 is preferred for artifacts with logs.
- Target close: We are aiming for a vendor decision by end of February; an ideal timeline would be contract executed by 2026-02-28.

Availability for a kickoff call: Tue 20 Jan 10am ET or Wed 21 Jan 11am ET. Please book and include a brief agenda focused on evidence owners, data handling Qs, and pilot acceptance criteria.

I’ve attached a quick internal checklist of what we typically expect for SOC 2 review — I’ll drop that into the S3 folder once it’s provisioned.

Regards,
Alyssa Chen
Security Lead, Nebula Health
alyssa.chen@nebulahealth.com

Attachments: nebula_internal_soc2_checklist.xlsx (stub)

Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 11:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Compliance contacts & SOC 2 evidence plan

Alyssa / Sean —

Thanks — this is perfect. I’ll act as the engagement lead on the MAP side and coordinate timelines and the kickoff call. Action items I’ll take offline:
- Create the MAP in our shared Drive and populate the milestone dates against your target 2026-02-28 close. (I’ll share the link in the calendar invite.)
- Populate the SOC 2 evidence template with the low-friction items we can provide immediately (config screenshots, network diagrams, current SOC 2 scope statement).
- Book kickoff: Tue 20 Jan, 10:00–10:45 ET (proposed). I’ve tentatively booked a slot and will send a calendar invite with the Drive link and proposed agenda.

A couple of clarifying notes for the kickoff agenda:
- Evidence owners: we’ll go item-by-item and assign owners (Nebula vs Redwood) on the call
- Data handling POC: please confirm who on your team owns data retention and deletion requirements so we can map to our data-flow docs
- Pilot acceptance: what metrics or checkboxes (latency, PII redaction, throughput) would constitute a successful pilot?

CC’ing Vivek and Soojin from our side for the technical/compliance details — they’ll be on the kickoff call and can take post-call follow-ups on evidence.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com

Attachment references: I’ll upload the populated soc2_evidence_request.pdf + proposed_map_v1.xlsx to the shared folder before the call.

Alyssa / team —

Quick tech notes ahead of the kickoff:
- Data handling POC: Soojin (cc’d) is our data-governance contact and will coordinate any retention/deletion proof points.
- We support customer-managed KMS and can provide key-handling docs and a KMS architecture diagram (see attachment: kms_diagram.png). We’ll also include audit-log extraction steps for the pilot environment.
- For evidence transfer: S3 with time-limited creds works fine — please include the bucket name in the invite or in a secure note and we’ll pull artifacts into our evidence tracker.

I’ll be on the call and can answer questions about logging, encryption at rest/in transit, and KV cache persistence during the pilot. If there are specific log formats you need (CloudTrail-style vs application logs), flag them now so we can prep.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
